messages:
Priya: Quick thing — console is blocking saves with an 'error' for an override key that's only meant for telemetry. Seen on a few customer configs. Example snippet:

Priya: ```yaml
routes:
  - match:
      path: /api
    overrides:
      headers:
        x-org: eq: "$org_id"
      telemetry:
        label: "tenant"
```

Alex: Hmm. Is 'telemetry' considered part of the official overrides schema? Our linter treats unknown keys as errors by default.

preflight-bot: preflight-lint: unknown field 'telemetry' at /routes/0/overrides — severity: error. See https://redwood.dev/preflight/XYZ for details.

Morgan: We started adding structured telemetry in a few repos, so that key is valid for hosted usage. We shouldn't block saves — at most warn and link to docs.

Kai: Implementation Q: where does this key get defined? Schema comes from the proto->json schema generator. If telemetry isn't in proto, linter will always be strict. :thinking_face:

Sasha: UX ask: if we can't change schema immediately, can the Console show a contextual hint and let the user 'Save anyway (record audit)'? That would avoid flow breaks for customers on new fields. :eyes:

Alex: Concern: letting unknown keys through could silently change behavior for Dedicated/Private installs that don't support telemetry. We need to map lint severity based on deployment target (hosted vs private).

Priya: Proposal: change linter rule for unknown override subkeys — if the key matches a whitelisted experimental list (e.g., telemetry, quotaHints, costCategory) downgrade to WARNING and surface an inline migration hint + docs link. Emit an event when user overrides the warning.

Morgan: +1. Also suggest adding an autofix suggestion where possible (e.g., rename common typos) and a migration button to convert old shapes to the new structure.

Kai: Implementation idea: add an 'experimentalKeys' array to the generated schema metadata. Console and preflight can read that to decide severity. That avoids changing core schema semantics.

console-bot: Action: Jira RED-1234 created — "support experimentalKeys in schema & lint severity mapping". Assignee: @Alex. Sprint: next.

Alex: I'll pick up RED-1234. Plan: update schema generator to emit experimentalKeys, make preflight-docker treat those as warnings, and add unit tests covering YAML samples. Quick fix: make preflight error => warning if key == 'telemetry' and route.path != '/internal'.

Priya: Great — I'll add a short docs blurb and a console tooltip explaining the downgrade rule and the telemetry event we'll emit when users accept warnings. Thanks y'all. :sparkles:
